prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a new PRIMARINA-PING: Pokémon Primarina transformed into a tiny Catch! Teenieping-style magical creature matching the MyStarQuest project.
Reference image 1 is Primarina and supplies the character identity and signature features. Reference images 2 and 3 are the project's Heartping and Auroraping; use them for Teenieping anatomy, expressive face, sculpted hair and polished 3D rendering, not their pink colors or props.
The result must unmistakably read as a Teenie Ping with strong Primarina identity: giant softly squared rounded head about 60 percent of overall character height, enormous glossy ocean-blue eyes with bright white catchlights and delicate lashes, tiny pink button nose, small joyful open smile, pearly white face, rosy cheeks and a miniature rounded torso with short cute flipper-like arms. Do not keep Primarina's long seal muzzle or elongated neck. Give her a magnificent aqua/turquoise swept forelock and high flowing curled ponytail bound with large white pearl beads, the iconic coral-pink five-point star ornament beside one eye, and Primarina's pale blue scalloped fin-shaped hair crest. Hair is sculpted into soft chunky rounded locks like the project Teeniepings.
Translate Primarina's pale periwinkle neck frills into a small scalloped collar and flouncy skirt-like waist frill. Keep a compact ocean-blue mermaid/seal tail curling beside the tiny body, with subtle pink fin accents and a pale blue and white fan-shaped tail fin; no long adult mermaid torso. On the white belly put a small tasteful gold royal emblem in the project's Teenieping style. One flipper-like hand waves. Cheerful floating/seated pose that shows the whole character and tail clearly, with rounded cute anatomy, no human adult proportions.
Style: premium polished 3D children's animation exactly compatible with the reference project portraits, softly luminous pearly skin, smooth glossy hair, gentle subsurface shading, charming and playful. Aqua, sea blue, pearly white, periwinkle and soft coral pink palette. Retain signature Primarina details instead of making a generic blue princess.
One character only, centered full body, nearly frontal three-quarter view, entire ponytail, pearl chain, star, waving hand and tail fin inside the image with a generous clear margin. Genuine transparent background, no environment or ground plane. No added wand, companion, text, title, border, logo or watermark.
